title: Tidy Schedule Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Roborock sessions (`roborock:session`), Tidy schedules (`tidy:schedule`), cleaning checklists (`cleaning:checklist`), and vacuum runtime logs (`vacuum:runtime`).
app: Roborock vacuum session exports, Tidy scheduling logs, cleaning checklists, and runtime telemetry from robot vacuums ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=tidy:schedule
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(task_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Tidy schedule events land each day and how many distinct task values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Tidy schedule records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct task values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how much Tidy schedule activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
